ROOT.functiondef: CREATE FUNCTION CDN.Prod_TechnologiaCzynnoscIdent (@Id INT) RETURNS VARCHAR(400) AS BEGIN declare @nameDzl as varchar(400) declare @namePom as varchar(40) declare @IdParent as Int SET @nameDzl = '' SELECT @IdParent = PTC_Ojciec from CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci where PTC_Id = @Id WHILE @Id > 0 BEGIN select @namePom = Cast(PTC_Id As Varchar) , @Id = PTC_Ojciec from CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci where PTC_Id = @Id SET @nameDzl = @namePom + '.'+ @nameDzl END IF Len(@nameDzl) > 0 SET @nameDzl = Substring(@nameDzl, 1, len(@nameDzl)-1) Return @nameDzl END
